text:
katie (mktg): Quick heads-up — Cobalt Nova case study interview confirmed Fri 10am PST. Need a short 1–2 sentence customer quote + legal signoff by Wed EOD so we can lock the launch post + webinar registration copy. Recording-bot will post transcript after the call. Agenda and sample Qs: https://drive.redwood/cobalt-nova/interview-notes :spiral_note_pad:

aj (content): Got it. I put a draft quote in the doc (bottom of page). Suggest: "Redwood helped us cut inference cost by 3x without sacrificing latency." — we can refine after the interview.

olivia (legal): Will review for any customer confidentiality redlines. Please tag exact product names and any numbers used in the quote. If anything mentions PII or revenue numbers we need a POA.

ben (sales-ops): For webinar lead routing — yes, route registrants to AE queue A for the first 48 hours, then to nurture. Also want to capture "interested_in_dedicated" as an attribute. Jamie, can you add this to the HubSpot form?

jamie (mktgops): On it. Proposed routing rule (confirm):
```
if form.interest == "dedicated" then assign -> AE Queue A
else if register_clicks > 0 then assign -> SDR nurture
```
Will add hidden field `interested_in_dedicated`.

maria (demand): Promo plan — 2 tweets, 1 LinkedIn post, and an email to the benchmark list. Want to coordinate timing: publish post + open webinar reg at 9am PST, webinar in 2 weeks. Need the approved quote and logo permission before copy goes live.

katie (mktg): Olivia — can you aim for Wed EOD signoff? If legal needs more context I'll set up a quick sync with the customer. Also can someone from sales confirm we're okay to include the 3x cost number?

olivia (legal): Wed EOD is fine if the quote stays high-level. If you want the explicit "3x" callout, we need a short attestation from Cobalt Nova on their benchmark methodology or we'll use a softer phrasing like "multi-fold" improvement.

ben (sales-ops): I can get an attestation. I'll ping the AE owner today and ask for either the attestation or permission to soften the language.

aj (content): If attestation is delayed, draft copy with softer phrasing so we can keep timelines. I can make two variants in the announcement doc (hard number vs. qualitative).

recording-bot: Transcript uploaded: https://drive.redwood/cobalt-nova/transcript-2141590000.txt

katie (mktg): Thanks team. To-do list I pulled together: 1) Ben: attestation or permission on numbers (today) 2) Olivia: legal review + logo usage (Wed EOD) 3) AJ: two copy variants (soft/hard) + final quote placement (Tue) 4) Jamie: add hidden field + routing rule (Tue) 5) Maria: promo schedule locked once quote/logo are approved. I'll follow up tomorrow with a short A/B plan for the webinar CTA. :thumbsup:

maria (demand): Perfect. Also, can we get a quick approval flow for inbound demo requests from the webinar? Idea: those routed to AE Queue A get a priority tag and 24-hr SLA.

ben (sales-ops): Agree. I'll set the priority tag and SLA in HubSpot. Will share the flow after I configure it (ETA Wed).

katie (mktg): Awesome — wrapping up here. If any blockers pop up add them inline in the doc and call out @olivia if it's legal. Thanks! :pray:
